item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"needs_review\\\": false,\\n    \\\"changed\\\": []\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases = [\\n    ({'declared':['b','a','a','ignored'], 'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':{'z':1,'a':2}}, 'b':{'kind':'missing'}, 'ignored':1, 'extra':0}, 'current':{'a':{'meta':{'a':2,'z':1},'hash':'x','kind':'file'}, 'ignored':2, 'other':3}}, {'ignored':['ignored']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n    ({'declared':['gone','new','same'], 'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}, 'same':{'kind':'missing'}}, 'current':{'new':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone','new']}),\\n    ({'declared':['x'], 'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'n','timestamp':1}}, 'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'n','timestamp':2}}}, {}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),\\n]\\nfor req, pol, expected in cases:\\n    before = (copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol))\\n    got = evaluate(req, pol)\\n    assert got == expected, (got, expected)\\n    assert (req, pol) == before\\nprint('synthetic checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nexpected=[evaluate(request, policy) for request in requests]\\nassert report == expected, (report, expected)\\nprint('report check passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--check\"]}}]}"}
